severity_definitions.critical: Absence of a control required to account for capital or reconstruct execution.
severity_definitions.high: A control exists but is incorrect or unwired in a way that invalidates a safety or evidence claim.
severity_definitions.medium: Material correctness or operability defect with a bounded workaround.

findings.title: No independent equity/capital reconciliation
evidence: scripts/r4_rebalance_loop.py uses account_info() equity for sizing and daily-loss checks
no internal equity ledger exists in the live path
reports/r4_loop/runtime_state.json (2026-10-29) contains daily_start=5107.83 and daily_loss.baseline_equity=18177.0 in the same record
reports/r4_loop/last_equity.json (2026-09-27) records equity=5117.15
the observed ~3.5x equity change between those dates has no capital-event record
reports/audits/EC_AUDIT_009_P0_1_EQUITY_RECONCILIATION.md records P0-1 as BLOCKED - BROKER STATEMENT REQUIRED; the diagnostic tool is not wired to the live loop
findings.impact: Trading P&L cannot be distinguished from deposits, withdrawals, broker corrections, or a stale baseline; daily-loss protection may run against the wrong capital base.
acceptance_criteria: Append-only equity ledger persisted with timestamps and hashes
Per-cycle broker-vs-ledger equity comparison recorded
Daily-loss baseline derived from ledger and immutable intraday
Unexplained delta above tolerance alerts and blocks new entries

findings.title: Capital-event ledger not wired into live path
evidence: src/eigencapital/production_qual/event_ledger.py defines EventLedger
grep finds no EventLedger construction or use in src/ or scripts/ outside production_qual
findings.impact: Capital movements cannot be reconstructed; no accounting spine for external audit or scaling.
acceptance_criteria: EventLedger instantiated in the live loop
Capital events written with correlation IDs
get_trade_chain() returns a full chain for a live cycle

findings.title: Durable decision-intent-order-fill chain absent from live path
evidence: no import of AuditLog or DurableAudit in scripts/r4_rebalance_loop.py
DurableAudit is used only by src/eigencapital/live/campaign.py
execute_orders uses an in-memory (symbol, side) dedup set per cycle
findings.impact: Ambiguous sends and restarts cannot be reconstructed or safely deduplicated; no durable execution provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Every decision, intent, submission, fill, rejection and reconciliation appended to one hash-chained log
Chain keyed by cycle and decision ID
Restart re-reads open intents and resolves them against the broker before submitting

findings.title: Stop-loss gate treats invalid SL as protected and is optional
evidence: src/eigencapital/live/risk_enforcement.py:415-430 uses p.get('sl', 0) == 0
require_sl_on_positions=false in production config
tests/unit/live/test_stop_loss_policy.py::TestInvalidDataGap: 3 xfailed (14 passed, 3 xfailed)
findings.impact: Gate 6 cannot assert that every position is protected; catastrophic supervisor mitigates but does not replace the check.
acceptance_criteria: None, non-positive, wrong-side and non-numeric SL count as unprotected and BLOCK
Tests un-xfailed
Gate enablement remains an explicit operator decision

findings.title: Reconciliation compares broker state to itself
evidence: scripts/r4_rebalance_loop.py:1680-1705 builds BrokerState and InternalState from the same pos_list
findings.impact: Position count, quantity, side and ticket mismatches can never be detected; RECONCILED is not evidence of agreement.
acceptance_criteria: InternalState derived from persisted confirmed fills
Tests for broker-only position, missing position, and quantity delta each produce MISMATCH or HALT

findings.title: Reconciliation result never persisted; dashboard reads a different file
evidence: scripts/r4_rebalance_loop.py:1740-1766 cycle_counter always 0 and last_cycle initializes to 0, so the append is always skipped
dashboard/services/dashboard_state.py:1013 reads reconciliation_state.json
loop targets reconciliation_state.jsonl
findings.impact: No durable reconciliation history; the dashboard cannot show engine truth.
acceptance_criteria: Monotonic cycle ID persisted
One record per cycle or state change
Loop and dashboard agree on path and schema
Test asserts the file exists after a cycle

findings.title: Advertised max_absolute_weight_error veto is not implemented
evidence: src/eigencapital/config.py:173 max_absolute_weight_error=0.05
configs/production/config.toml:202-204 documents SKIPPED_MIN_LOT / no order on breach
scripts/r4_rebalance_loop.py:801-839 records the error and states in a comment that it is not an execution veto
is_feasible checks only 0 < executable_notional <= MAX_POSITION_USD
findings.impact: Orders are deliberately submitted that the config documents as skipped. Exposure remains bounded by the per-position notional cap, but the advertised control does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: Breach blocks the order with an auditable reason, or the claim is removed from config and docs with written risk acceptance

findings.title: Probability of Backtest Overfitting structurally constant 1.0
evidence: src/eigencapital/analytics/validation/pbo.py:88-114 uses a single deterministic disjoint half-split
best_is_idx is selected from train and can never appear in test
runtime: 12 candidates -> pbo=1.0, overfit_count=6, total_partitions=6
reports cite PBO 1.000 (16/16)
findings.impact: Reported PBO values are artifacts; the metric carries no information in either direction.
acceptance_criteria: CSCV implementation
Unit test with known-PBO synthetic matrix
Affected research values re-derived

findings.title: Holm/BH multiple-testing correction invalid
evidence: src/eigencapital/analytics/validation/multiple_testing.py:63-129 sorts adjusted values before mapping back
findings.impact: Holm is anti-conservative for the largest raw p; a test with p=0.03 is rejected at alpha=0.05 when correct Holm would retain it. FWER/FDR guarantees do not hold.
acceptance_criteria: Correct step-down and step-up algorithms
Property tests for monotonicity and error-rate bounds
Affected verdicts re-run

findings.title: Research provenance and cited artifacts are not reproducible
evidence: EXP-000002 stored provenance_hash 1b81... does not reproduce (e549.../fbb4...)
repository.load() never verifies the hash
dataset_hash matches R5_data_manifest.json with 38 instruments; experiment claims 42; production allows 37 (30 tradeable)
all six R1-R6 artifact directories cited by program_status.json are absent
git_commit fda2468 is unresolvable
findings.impact: Research conclusions cannot be audited or reproduced; reports reference evidence that does not exist in the repository.
acceptance_criteria: Hash verified on load
Dataset manifest tied to the experiment universe
Artifacts present or claims withdrawn
Commit reachable or provenance restated

findings.title: Live signal includes the forming D1 bar
evidence: scripts/r4_rebalance_loop.py:515 copy_rates_from_pos(sym, TIMEFRAME_D1, 0, bars) includes index 0
no bar-completion filter found
findings.impact: Hourly recomputation on an evolving daily bar causes signal churn, non-reproducible daily weights, and avoidable turnover.
acceptance_criteria: Signal pinned to the last closed bar, or intraday-update semantics explicitly documented and tested

findings.title: Execution robustness gaps
evidence: detect_filling_mode always returns ORDER_FILLING_FOK
deviation hard-coded 10 (line 995) and 20 (line 2564), not max_slippage
ambiguous timeout breaks without broker resolution
partial fill treated as failed
no chase despite max_chase_attempts
idempotency key in memory per cycle only
findings.impact: Higher rejection and partial-fill risk; unresolved sends after crash; possible duplicate exposure in edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Broker-capability-based filling mode
Config-driven deviation
Resolve ambiguous sends by client order ID
Partial-fill repair path
Durable dedup keys

findings.title: Execution and rebalance config fields unconsumed
evidence: no consumer in the live loop for max_chase_attempts, max_age_seconds, max_cumulative_slippage_bps, max_order_frequency, rebalance_frequency
findings.impact: Operators can set limits that have no effect; false assurance.
acceptance_criteria: Enforce or remove each field
Config-consumption test for every safety key

findings.title: Dashboard misreports account, risk, health and reconciliation state
evidence: dashboard/services/dashboard_state.py:626 calls mt5.shutdown() before positions_get(), so unrealized_pnl is always 0
daily_loss_remaining set to max_daily_loss and never decremented
get_system_health does not staleness-gate the alive flag
get_reconciliation_status derives CLEAN from SL presence and never reads the intent ledger
_empty_account_state returns equity=0 and balance=0 with freshness UNKNOWN
reports/r4_loop/last_health.json shows alive=true with timestamp 2026-09-27 while runtime_state.json is dated 2026-10-29
findings.impact: Operators may see a healthier or safer state than reality.
acceptance_criteria: Correct MT5 call order
Remaining loss derived from the same baseline as the risk engine
Staleness TTL on health
Reconciliation from the engine record
Explicit UNKNOWN rendering for missing data

findings.title: Predictable default dashboard key and auth bypass switch
evidence: dashboard/api/app.py and dashboard/streaming/events.py default to dev-key-change-in-production
DASHBOARD_DISABLE_AUTH=1 bypasses auth
legacy ?token= accepted for WebSocket
loopback bind in scripts/start_dashboard.sh
start_dashboard.sh exports VITE_API_KEY, embedding the same key in the frontend bundle
findings.impact: A local misconfiguration can expose live state under a known credential; risk is reduced but not eliminated by loopback binding.
acceptance_criteria: Fail closed in production when the key is missing or default
Remove query-token acceptance
Loud startup warning when auth is disabled

findings.title: Risk-gate call semantics and daily-loss baseline fallback
evidence: RiskEnforcer.check_all called with target_orders=0 before order generation
src/eigencapital/live/risk_enforcement.py _check_daily_loss auto-initializes baseline when audit is CLEAN
findings.impact: The concurrency gate cannot see planned orders; a restart at a loss can silently restart the daily-loss clock from the lower equity.
acceptance_criteria: Call with the actual planned order count
Baseline must come from the persistent ledger (RESTORED) or trading is refused

findings.title: Audit chain is unkeyed and event IDs can race
evidence: durable_audit.py hashes prev_hash|seq|payload with plain SHA-256 and no key
AuditLog event counter is reconstructed by replay
findings.impact: An attacker with write access to both primary and mirror can recompute a consistent chain; concurrent processes can duplicate event IDs.
acceptance_criteria: HMAC with a key held outside the repository
Sequence allocated under the existing file lock
Periodic chain-head digest exported off-host

findings.title: Backtest fill model unsuitable for scaling evidence
evidence: backtest/engine.py uses fixed tick_size=0.25 and quantity=1.0
fills at bar close with static spread/slippage
no margin, financing, liquidation, or partial fills
trade_count approximated as fill_events // 2
findings.impact: Useful for relative comparison and look-ahead testing; not a basis for capacity, slippage, or drawdown claims.
acceptance_criteria: Per-instrument contract and tick metadata
Risk-based sizing
Intrabar stop and gap handling
Broker-spec cost model
Limitations disclosed in reports

findings.title: CI and supply-chain hardening gaps
evidence: GitHub Actions referenced by tag, not commit SHA
no permissions block
unpinned runtime dependencies
no dependency vulnerability scan
Codecov fail_ci_if_error=false
CI matrix 3.11-3.13 while local review used 3.14.8
findings.impact: Non-reproducible builds and increased supply-chain exposure; Python 3.14 is untested in CI.
acceptance_criteria: SHA-pinned actions
permissions: contents: read
Lockfile or hashes for operational installs
pip-audit
Explicit Python 3.14 support decision

findings.title: Experiment registry is mutable and no promotion path exists
evidence: ExperimentRecord is a mutable dataclass
repository.save() overwrites and delete() exists
_MODIFIABLE_BEFORE_FREEZE is dead code
no code promotes research into production
findings.impact: Evidence can be altered post hoc; there is no formal research-to-live gate.
acceptance_criteria: Immutable records with content-addressed IDs
Append-only supersession
Promotion checklist enforced or documented as out of scope

findings.title: Simulation executors importable in the production package
evidence: SIMULATED_EVIDENCE and hardcoded executors are production modules referenced only by tests today
findings.impact: Latent fabrication path if any future wiring selects them in a promotion or reporting context.
acceptance_criteria: Move under tests/ or raise at import unless a test flag is set
Test asserting they cannot be selected outside tests

findings.title: Operational state files have no schema or version
evidence: reports/r4_loop/* JSON and JSONL files carry no schema version
readers use .get() defaults
naming is inconsistent between producers and consumers
findings.impact: Format changes become silent parse failures or dropped fields.
acceptance_criteria: Version field in each file
Readers reject unknown versions explicitly
One documented owner per file

findings.title: Documentation drift and absent governing specs
evidence: scripts/r4_rebalance_loop.py:163-168 comments say 1500 and 8 while actual values are 5000 and 20
SYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md and domain_contracts.md do not exist
EC-AUDIT-009 is draft and not adopted
findings.impact: Misleading during incident response; readers may assume controls that are not enforced.
acceptance_criteria: Fix stale comments
Mark nonexistent specs as historical references
State the adopted gate explicitly

findings.title: Dashboard repeat reads and in-memory rate limiting
evidence: REST handlers re-read many files per request
per-IP rate limiter is an in-memory dict
5 s broadcaster interval
findings.impact: Unnecessary I/O; multi-worker deployments multiply effective rate limits.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot cache shared with the broadcaster
Single-worker requirement documented or external limiter used
